text.11:108: And as for those who will be glad (that day) they will be in the Garden, abiding there so long as the heavens and the earth endure save for that which thy Lord willeth: a gift unfailing.
text.17:20: Each do We supply, both these and those, from the bounty of thy Lord. And the bounty of thy Lord can never be walled up.
text.38:39: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning.
text.78:36: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
